name: ciudades-sagradas
description: Atlas interactivo de ciudades sagradas del Perú antiguo

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/build-sw.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.qa:playwright:smoke: npm run build && playwright test tests/qa/atlas.spec.js tests/qa/lod1.spec.js tests/qa/lazy-viewer.spec.js tests/qa/accessibility.spec.js tests/qa/render-on-demand.spec.js tests/qa/offline.spec.js tests/qa/qa-api.spec.js tests/qa/sw-network.spec.js tests/qa/viewer-camera.spec.js tests/qa/viewer-context.spec.js tests/qa/viewer-load-cancel.spec.js --project=chromium-desktop-1600
scripts.qa:playwright:webkit: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_WEBKIT=1 playwright test --project=webkit-desktop --project=webkit-mobile
